Package org.keycloak.connections.infinispan.shutdown

Class WaitConditionShutdownListener

java.lang.Object
org.keycloak.connections.infinispan.shutdown.WaitConditionShutdownListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShutdownListener
public class WaitConditionShutdownListener extends Object implements ShutdownListener
A ShutdownListener that blocks the shutdown thread until a ShutdownCondition is no longer in progress, or until the provided deadline elapses.

External events should invoke check() whenever the condition may have changed (e.g. after a topology change event). If the condition has cleared, the waiting shutdown thread is unblocked and ShutdownCondition.complete() is called. If the timeout expires first, ShutdownCondition.onTimeout() is called instead.
